The 40-scene approved source and 16 stages are checked programmatically. Exhaustive rendered playthrough of all scenes, every tooltip and physical Android input were not performed.

User music approval covers source recordings. Decoding, gain/peak/seam metrics, real player stream routing and pause/resume are tested using dummy audio. Actual audible game transitions remain unverified.
